prerequisites: Separate reviewed full integration and cap/role review
ROOT-specific finite authorization for actual read-only compatibility probes; retain original guards as authority until adoption is approved
Resolve hard-timeout/cleanup containment before any adoption
prohibited_shortcuts: Do not infer actual timing or historical nvidia-smi counts from source invocation counts
Do not drop unknown processes or accept missing memory as zero
Do not round process memory in either direction without a new proven compatible guard design
Do not use CLI fallback or old-GPU fallback
Do not replace hard-timeout semantics with a nominal elapsed check
Do not run numerical/scientific qualification to validate inventory transport

steps.acceptance: Bind candidate and private seam hashes, exact original pinned consumers, project Python/no-user-site policy, actual canonical NVML shared-library path/hash/version and required public symbols. Do not install or enable user-site packages. Missing symbols/version/ABI or differing source blocks.
steps.action: Authenticate the complete future source closure and actual runtime.

steps.acceptance: Use complete raw metadata with bounded evidence size under its authorized scope. Require all physical indices/UUIDs, GPU0 immutable UUID, complete PID sets, exact process names and process MiB, total memory and utilization semantics. For stable samples require exact integral-process output and conservative device-memory bounds. Changing samples are inconclusive. Unknown/permission/MIG/name/rounding mismatches block and must never be ignored, padded with guessed values, or converted to empty lists.
steps.action: Record actual full original device and compute inventory versus the NVML callable using bracketed original-A / NVML-B / original-C sequences.

steps.acceptance: Confirm nvmlDeviceGetComputeRunningProcesses_v3 represents the exact original --query-compute-apps population on this host and current modes. Confirm name API returns the actual title expected by the pinned known-worker predicates. Do not alter external processes to manufacture cases. Fractional process memory, unsupported modes or opaque rows stop compatibility qualification.
steps.action: Verify physical, compute-only, MPS, non-compute residual and process-name semantics.

steps.acceptance: Every H058/C3 cap, original title/identity, native-context absence, fixed C3/H058/evaluator envelope, max(external sum, driver residual), actual free memory and 4GiB headroom inequality must remain exact. Synthetic adversarial cases remain required, but actual observations cannot be invented. Candidate must not authorize any sample the original predicates reject on equivalent complete metadata.
steps.action: Run the exact original capacity/classification predicates on complete authenticated captured metadata and current authorized identities.

steps.acceptance: The 30-second checks here reject late returns only. Separate design must demonstrate required deadline/cancellation/cleanup behavior if one C call never returns, without inventing a hard NVML timeout, hidden permanent thread, rate reduction or unowned helper. No adoption until this requirement is settled by source/lifecycle review and appropriately bounded non-scientific qualification.
steps.action: Review driver-call timeout containment and owned lifecycle.

steps.acceptance: Install a private base view only for the fresh reviewed route, with real_inventory mapped to the candidate and every other required primitive delegated to the authenticated original. Bind each actual supervisor/worker private view. No installed/original module/file edits, current-job mutation, stale inventory cache, old-route reactivation, GPU eligibility change, missing call site, exception swallowing, helper-row ignore or shared controller/H058 rewrite. Execute exact seam in RAM with call-count evidence, including all prepared-feature checks and original 2-second supervisor cadence; account every source and evidence role under the original caps.
steps.action: Review complete interpreter-local integration and fresh capacity/source-role bounds.

steps.acceptance: Preserve all existing sources, policies, clocks, scopes, failures, charges, live jobs and unknown historical waits/drain. A source or compatibility pass alone grants no admission, retry, completion, close, credit, speedup or scientific result. Optional later measured query timing must remain separate from numerical/scientific claims.
steps.action: ROOT alone decides separately authorized activation and any real execution.
